the act: *** The double wedding. *** Santisima Trinidad, *** 25 APRIL 1889 ***, two marriages. Index arks 1:1:XS6N-5CV6 and 1:1:XS6N-5CVL.
what the index says: *** MARIA LERENA ***, b. c.1867, and *** CASIMIRA LERENA ***, b. c.1869, both 'hijas de BERNABE LERENA y CASIMIRA PELAEZ', married *** ELISEO CARDOSO *** and *** JUAN BASILIO CARDOSO ***.
what it settles: *** THE SECOND SISTER IS NEW TO THIS ARCHIVE *** and so is the fact that the two weddings were one event. Together with the 1888 marriage it supplies *** BOTH BLOOD PATHS *** the 1911 expediente calls a double impediment.

the act: *** Bernabe the younger's marriage. *** Santisima Trinidad, *** 22 MARCH 1888 ***.
what the index says: *** BERNABE LERENA ***, b. c.1863, son of Bernabe Lerena and Casimira Pelaez, married *** FLORINDA CARDOSO ***.
what it settles: Dates a marriage this archive held only as a pairing, and confirms his parents from a second record. *** HE IS THE FATHER OF CUSTODIO. ***

the act: *** Custodio and Ema. *** Santisima Trinidad, *** 18 SEPTEMBER 1911 ***.
what the index says: *** CUSTODIO LERENA ***, b. c.1889, son of *** BERNABE LERENA and FLORINDA CARDOZO ***, married *** EMA [CARDOZO] ***.
what it settles: *** THE DISPENSATION WAS GRANTED, AND NOW IT IS THE ACT THAT SAYS SO *** rather than an inference from their daughter's birth in 1915.

the act: *** Socorro's marriage. *** Santisima Trinidad, *** 15 JULY 1885 ***. Index ark 1:1:XS6J-975Z.
what the index says: *** SOCORRO LERENA ***, b. c.1855, married *** SERAPIO FERNANDEZ ***.
what it settles: Dates a marriage this register had only as a relationship, and puts a *** second Lerena wedding at Trinidad in 1885 *** beside the dispensation already held for that year.

the act: *** Aurora's parents. *** Civil registrations of her children at Trinidad, 1891-1904. Index ark 1:1:XS6J-GBZQ.
what the index says: *** AURORA LERENA ***, b. c.1868, 'hija de *** ALEJANDRO F. LERENA *** y *** NATALIA LERENA ***', wife of *** MANUEL VAQUERO ***, at least five children.
what it settles: *** A FOURTH LERENA-MARRIED-A-LERENA COUPLE *** - and it names ALEJANDRO F. LERENA, one of the two men work-list row 137 calls unworked, giving him a wife and a daughter for the first time.

the act: *** A child of the Rosario house at Trinidad. *** Santisima Trinidad, *** April 1882 ***.
what the index says: *** MANUEL LERENA ***, b. c.1856, 'hijo de *** MAURICIO LERENA *** y *** CASIMIRA MONTANA ***', married *** JACINTA MARINA ***.
what it settles: *** A SECOND, INDEPENDENT THREAD FROM COLLA-ROSARIO TO TRINIDAD ***, alongside the bridge in data/colla-trinidad-bridge.tsv. Mauricio and Casimira married at Colla in 1837; their son was marrying in Flores by 1882.
